description: Garage cluster: the storage nodes on the NAS, Unraid and syn1621, and the edge gateways in the cluster.

panels.title: Cluster
panels.description: Worst view across all nodes. Healthy: every partition has all its nodes up. Degraded: some copies are missing but every partition still has quorum. Unavailable: some partitions lost quorum, so reads or writes fail.

panels.title: Partitions with quorum
panels.description: Share of partitions that can still reach write quorum, from the node with the worst view.

panels.title: Partitions all-OK
panels.description: Share of partitions with every replica's node up.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Peers connected, from the node with the fewest, against all peers any node knows. Includes the gateways.

panels.title: Storage nodes
panels.description: Nodes with a storage role that are up, against all storage roles in the layout.

panels.title: Replication
panels.description: replication_factor. Every node must run the same value.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Garage versions running, one entry per distinct version. More than one means an upgrade is half done.

panels.title: Layout
panels.description: Roles in the current layout, as one storage node sees them. Gateways have zone `cluster` and no capacity. A gateway missing here has no role yet and answers S3 requests with 403.

targets.expr: max by (id, role_zone, role_capacity, role_gateway) (cluster_layout_node_connected{job="garage", pod=""})

panels.title: Storage nodes
panels.description: Per storage node. Disk figures are the filesystems behind Garage's data and metadata directories, not Garage's own usage. A node still receiving its copy shows a resync queue and fewer objects than its peer.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (1 - garage_local_disk_avail{job="garage", pod="", volume="data"} / garage_local_disk_total{job="garage", pod="", volume="data"})

panels.title: Data disk free
panels.description: Free space on each storage node's data filesystem. With two copies over three zones, usable space is about the smaller of half the total and the total minus the largest node.

panels.title: Metadata disk free
panels.description: Free space under each storage node's sqlite metadata directory.

panels.title: Objects per storage node
panels.description: Rows in the object table. Both nodes hold every object, so the lines meet once a new node has caught up.

panels.title: Requests by endpoint
panels.description: S3 requests per second, all nodes.

panels.title: Errors by endpoint and status
panels.description: S3 error responses per second. 404 from HeadObject is normal client behaviour; 403 from a gateway usually means it has no layout role, 503 means no quorum.

panels.title: Requests by node
panels.description: Which node served S3. In-cluster clients go through the edge gateways; anything on a storage node came straight from the LAN.

panels.title: Latency quantiles
panels.description: S3 request duration over all endpoints and nodes.

panels.title: Mean latency by endpoint
panels.description: Mean S3 request duration per endpoint.

panels.title: Block throughput
panels.description: Block bytes written (up) and read (down) on each storage node, resync included.

panels.title: Resync queue
panels.description: Blocks waiting to be fetched or offloaded. Grows after a layout change and drains as the node catches up; errored blocks are retried with backoff.

panels.title: Resync rate
panels.description: Blocks processed by the resync workers per second.

panels.title: Table sync queues
panels.description: Non-empty table work queues per node. Merkle backlogs grow after a layout change while metadata syncs to the new layout version.

panels.title: Table rows
panels.description: Rows per metadata table, largest storage-node figure.

panels.title: RPC rate by endpoint
panels.description: Inter-node RPCs per second.

panels.title: RPC errors and timeouts
panels.description: RPC failures per second by the node that saw them. A peer that is down shows up here on every other node.

panels.title: Mean RPC duration by endpoint
panels.description: Mean inter-node RPC duration.

panels.title: Admin API
panels.description: Admin API requests per node: the operator, garage-ui and the metrics scrapes.

title: Garage
